# Draft:Call of War : 1942

Call of War is a real time strategic game based on the period between 1933 to 1945. You can manage a country in that game, so it is also a military-strategy, management and simulation game.
Strategy : There are three strategies you can choose from, rush, defense and economy. The job is to maintain a balance between them. Also, there are 36 units with different research tabs and you need to construct industry and produce troops, and most importantly, conquer new lands.
